business.name: Bubba Oasis
business.notes: The project owner identifies the former venue as Bubba Oasis and confirms it was closed by the photograph on 2026-04-03. Forge is the agent selling the property, not the venue name. The local BID directory describes a neighbourhood clubhouse with co-working, cocktails, music and events: https://www.thisisclapham.co.uk/business/bubba-oasis/ (checked 2026-10-29). Multi-site classification records the known Clapham and Islington locations: the current brand website https://bubbaoasis.com/ describes Islington; this is not a claim that both venues traded on the photograph date. The project owner supplied a community post at https://www.threads.com/@bestofclaphamldn/post/DPL5bFwguHK/ and its publication date, 2025-09-29. Its supplied text reports the Clapham venue had closed and that it opened in July 2023. The post could not be independently retrieved. September 29 is the report date, not an established final trading day; July 2023 is a reported opening month, not a precise date. No historical occupied period is invented.
